records.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-04: Requirement block copied from the 2026-2027 catalog program page. Evidence: sources/pipeline/IN/2026-10-04/evidence.json#2f815a59803418ac. Corrected 2026-10-07 (issue #119 review, independent re-check against the archived source): Ambiguous as printed: A second 'Supporting Required: 1' label is printed above PHIL 255, PHYS 111, PHYS 112, PSYC 305, which supports the record's all_required reading. However, in the layout these four rows are indented with blank credit cells, exactly like the BIO 240/318/340/417 members of 'Choose 3-4 courses from the following: | 11-12'. The first Supporting Required block, by contrast, is unindented and prints credits. The printed total also has no room for them: required courses 28 cr (4+4+3+4+3+3+3+1+3) + first supporting block 12 cr (4+2+3+3) + the 11-12 cr choice = 51-52, the printed 'Total Credits | 51-52'. Requiring four more courses would push the total far above that. So the page can be read either as four more required supporting courses (the label) or as further members of the choose 3-4 list under a stray comment row (indentation and arithmetic). The arithmetic favors the choice-member reading. The rule_text 'Total Credits 51-52' is just the table total. How the source reads: Most consistent with the printed total: choose 3-4 courses (11-12 credits) from BIO 240, 318, 340, 417, PHIL 255, PHYS 111, PHYS 112, PSYC 305.
